top_signals.title: How Tokenization Could Change the ETF Market
top_signals.summary: Giang Bui, Head of Issuer Growth at Securitize, Jason Emery, Head of Product Management at DTCC Digital Assets, and Will Peck, Head of WisdomTree Onchain, join Bloomberg Intelligence's James Seyffart at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. The panel examines how tokenization could expand the utility and distribution of ETFs, from collateral mobility and faster settlement to new ways of reaching global investors. They also discuss where the technology is already gaining traction and how traditional and onchain markets could converge over time. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Regulator Probing Nvidia’s Accounting, Reuters Says
top_signals.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating the accounting practices of Nvidia Corp., Reuters reported Friday, as the challenges facing the chipmaker continue to mount in the wake of Jensen Huang’s departure as chief executive officer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Canada Stocks Eye Longest Losing Streak Since 2023 on Tech Rout
top_signals.summary: Canada’s major equities index is on track to fall for seven straight sessions in a broad selloff sparked by technology and commodities stocks on Friday, marking the benchmark’s longest losing streak in three years.

top_signals.title: Apollo Enlists 13 Wall Street Banks for $9 Billion ADT Debt Deal
top_signals.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. has brought in 13 Wall Street lenders for a roughly $9 billion debt package it underwrote for Thrive Holdings Inc.’s acquisition of home security provider ADT Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.
